metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2008 · Jalsa
metas.description: Sanjay, a young man, joins an extremist group after having had a troublesome childhood. A policeman decides to guide him towards a far better path and in doing so, his daughter falls crazy with Sanjay.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2002 · Manmadhudu
metas.description: Abhiram, a misogynist, works as a manager in his own advertising agency. When his uncle, the chairman, appoints Harika as an assistant manager, he mistreats her, but his hatred soon turns into love.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Wild Horse Nine
metas.description: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Drones
metas.description: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2018 · 100 Days My Prince
metas.description: Upon losing his memory, a crown prince encounters a commoner's life and experiences unforgettable love as the husband to Joseon's oldest bachelorette.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2014 · Surviving Jack
metas.description: A boy becomes a man, and a man becomes a father, in a time before coming of age was something you could Google.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2009 · Fighting Spirit: New Challenger
metas.description: Ippo continues to defend his title and training to reach his goal, Ichiro Miyata. While Takamura goes for the world, and faces the world champion, Brian Hawk. In what is to become his toughest fight so far.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Eternally Yours
metas.description: Follows the journey of a married vampire couple struggling to accept their daughter's human boyfriend, after being together for 500 years.

metas.name: 2026 · Ali G: Who Iz I?
metas.description: Hip-hop journalist Ali G returns after 20 years to make a documentary with real people. Cameras follow him for over a year as he takes classes, walks the streets, and appears on shows, often with his pregnant girlfriend.
